LOCATIONS: AT THE NORTHWEST CORNER NEAR THE CONEX BOXES, THEN BEHIND BUILDING WHEN IT BECAME NOTICEABLE (OCCURRING FOR OVER 3 YEARS). - KNOWINGLY ALLOWS NORTH & SOUTH DIESEL PUMP HANDLES TO LEAK ONTO CONCRETE FUEL ISLAND, SPILLING APPROX 5 GALLONS OF DIESEL PER DAY; THIS SEEPS IN BETWEEN CONCRETE PAD INTO GROUND (OCCURRING FOR OVER 1 YEAR). - HIRES A 3RD PARTY CONTRACTOR TO WASH OILY TRUCKS DIRECTLY ONTO THE GROUND WITHOUT BEING PROPERLY COLLECTED BY A WASH BAY (APPROX EVERY OTHER SATURDAY). - MOBILE A/C RECHARGER UNIT CONTINUOUSLY LEAKS TO ATMOSPHERE, CAUSING A RECENT TRIP/SLIPPING INJURY. - ALTHOUGH NO OBSERVABLE DIRECT CONNECTION TO STORM DRAINS/ WATERWAYS, THESE INCIDENTS HAVE CONTAMINATED THE WELL WATER WHICH OCCASIONALLY CREATES AN OILY SHEEN/ SHIMMER IN THE BUILDING FAUCET WATER.

properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 1440173 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: PBI GORDON
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1440173
Incident Time: 2025-08-18 06:30:00
Nearest City: Kansas City, KS
Location: 300 S 3RD ST
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: 24D DMA SALT
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: PBI GORDON
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.099592, -94.615398 (Approximated from premise)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTING A RELEASE OF A HERBICIDE CONTAINING THREE SPECIFIC CHEMICALS. THESE ARE: (24D DMA SALT: 21377 POUNDS RELEASED) (DICAMBA DMA SALT: 1953 POUNDS RELEASED) AND (DIETHANOLAMINE: 10002 POUNDS RELEASED). THE HERBICIDE RELEASED FROM AN ONSITE STORAGE TANK TO FACILITY CONCRETE FLOORING. THE RELEASE REACHED A PIPE INTENDED TO LEAD TO ADDITIONAL CONTAINMENT, HOWEVER THE PIPE WAS PREVIOUSLY CUT ALLOWING THE RELEASE TO REACH LAND/SOIL. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS ATTRIBUTED TO A VALVE BEING LEFT OPEN OVER THE WEEKEND. IT IS BELIEVED THAT THERE WAS MOST LIKELY A BLOCKAGE IN THE SAMPLE PORT LINE; WHEN THE BLOCKAGE CLEARED THE MATERIAL DISCHARGED FROM THE STORAGE TANK VIA THE VALVE OUTLET.

AS I APPROACHED THE SITE IN QUESTION, I NOTICED THREE ORPHAN STORAGE TANKS SETTING APPROXIMATELY 2 METERS NORTH OF COUNTY ROAD 2250. Report Description///UPDATE TO REPORT # 1356358/// CALLER CALLED TO GIVE CONTACT INFORMATION SINCE THE ORIGINAL REPORT WAS PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED ANONYMOUSLY. CALLER ALSO STATED THE INCIDENT OCCURRED ON NOVEMBER 29, 2022. A REPRESENTATIVE FROM SILVER CREEK OIL AND GAS CALLED TO NOTIFTY THE REPORTING PARTY OF THE OIL AND SALT WATER RELEASED THAT ENTERED THEIR CATTLE STOCK POND. ORIGINAL REPORT # 1356358: CALLER STATED AN OIL TANK OVER FLOWED AND RELEASED A CRUDE OIL AND SALT WATER MIXTURE INTO A DIKE. THE DIKE THAN OVER FLOWED AND RELEASED THE MATERIAL INTO AN IN GROUND STOCK / TANK POND. CALLER STATED THE INCIDENT OCCURRED IN LATE NOVEMBER, 2022. THE CAUSE OF RELEASE WAS DUE TO OPERATOR ERROR.
